name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-team-bundle
description: Opt-in Agent Team collaboration bundle for DeepSeek Harness

scripts.typecheck: npm run generate:typert && tsc -p packages/agent-team/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/command-agent-team/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/tool-agent-team/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/client-agent-team/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: npm run generate:typert && tsc -p packages/agent-team/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/command-agent-team/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/tool-agent-team/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/client-agent-team/tsconfig.build.json && cd packages/client-agent-team && ../../../deepseek-harness/node_modules/.bin/tsdown
scripts.preview: node scripts/check-preview-credentials.mjs && npm run build && node scripts/run-preview.mjs
